description: Defines the AttendanceApi class, which provides methods for marking attendance and listing today's attendance data via API calls.

classes.name: AttendanceApi
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with attendance-related API endpoints, including marking attendance and retrieving today's attendance list.

methods.name: AttendanceApi
